content.headline: Common Questions About the Continuous Growth Loop

questions.question: How is this different from traditional evaluation systems?
questions.answer: EdCoachAi transforms coaching from episodic evaluation events into ongoing, supportive professional development. Teachers actively participate in their growth instead of passively receiving judgment. We supplement—never replace—formal evaluations.

questions.question: Will AI feedback be as good as human insight?
questions.answer: Our AI understands each teacher's PGP goal, rubric indicators, and observation evidence to generate hyper-contextualized feedback. Coaches edit and approve everything before sending. It's AI-assisted coaching, not AI replacement.

questions.question: How do you ensure FERPA compliance and data security?
questions.answer: We're built with FERPA compliance from day one. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit, with role-based access control. Teacher reflections are private to only the teacher and their coach. We maintain SOC 2 certification standards.

questions.question: What makes the 5-minute walkthroughs so efficient?
questions.answer: iPad-optimized forms focus on evidence capture, not lengthy narratives. AI handles the heavy lifting of connecting observations to PGP goals and generating feedback. Coaches spend time coaching, not writing reports.

questions.question: How do teachers actually engage with their feedback?
questions.answer: Teachers receive feedback in their private Growth Journal with guided reflection prompts. They can see their progress timeline, connect feedback to their PGP goals, and take ownership of their development journey. 80% complete reflections within 48 hours.

questions.question: Can this work with our existing rubric system?
questions.answer: EdCoachAi is built natively for the Louisiana Educator Rubric but can adapt to other rubric systems. Our Enterprise tier includes custom rubric indicator support for district-specific requirements.
